question: Which region has the highest median GDP (constant 2015 US$) value?
sql:
SELECT 
  region,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(value, 2)[OFFSET(1)] as median_gdp
FROM (
  SELECT 
    cs.region,
    id.value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.country_summary` cs ON id.country_code = cs.country_code
  WHERE id.indicator_code = 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD'
    AND id.value IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.region IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY median_gdp DESC
LIMIT 10
